name: Incident
description: Carries the honesty beat. Scenario B's surge demand, plus a genuine lane blockage on J1->J2 at t=240s. Indicators must fire from real measurement, and nothing may automate before an operator confirms.
demand_note: Same base + surge demand as Scenario B (see demo_b_surge.json's demand_note).

scripted_events.description: One auto-rickshaw departs directly onto E_J1_to_J2 and stops on lane 0 for 300s — a real SUMO <stop>, not a scripted 'pretend incident' flag. Live-verified via TraCI: lane mean speed collapses from a ~13.9 m/s free-flow baseline to nearly 0 m/s and detector occupancy (det_J2_W_0) spikes to 25-55% for the duration of the blockage, giving the real anomaly/incident-detection pipeline (Phase 6) genuine measurements to fire indicators from.
